posts.author: Cristiano_Perrucci
posts.content_md:
> **dave battin:** Were you able to acquire the mirrors for mold coating?

Oh yes i was!

It's a really useful advice using mirrors for mold coating, Dave.

I bought 6 large 25x25cm 6mm thik mirrors for a few euros.

Using mirrors instead of glass allow to kill several birds with one stone such as bubbles much more visible as well as small particles of dust, better coating flatness, water repellent traces are now well visible too.

Today i made 12 large (23x23cm) MBDCG plates for the next experiments of bandwidth control.

Cheers
